N-simon.objects: Banach spaces X,B,Y and a family F of trajectories.
N-simon.fixed_and_variable: T,p and injections are fixed; f varies over F.
N-simon.hypotheses: Continuous linear injections X->B->Y; X->B compact; uniform Lp(X) bound; uniform Lp(Y) translation decay.
N-simon.equations: Both family bounds and the exact (0,T-h) translation norm appear in the canonical display.
N-simon.quantifiers: The limit takes h down to zero after supremum over all f in F; no family-dependent constants.
N-simon.conclusion: Relative compactness in Lp(B), or continuous B representatives compact in C at p=infinity.
N-simon.status: Established journal theorem, not a new result.
N-simon.local_definitions: Compact injection is explained adjacent to use; the complete embedding chain is inside the statement.
